world_news.title: World Leaders Gather for Emergency Climate Summit in Geneva
world_news.summary: Heads of state from over 60 nations convened to address rising sea levels and extreme weather events that have displaced millions across Southeast Asia.

world_news.title: Historic Peace Agreement Signed Between Rival Nations After Decade of Conflict
world_news.summary: Diplomats hailed a landmark ceasefire as the most significant diplomatic breakthrough in a generation, paving the way for reconstruction and refugee returns.

world_news.title: Global Food Crisis Deepens as Harvest Failures Hit Three Continents
world_news.summary: The UN World Food Programme warned that over 300 million people face acute food insecurity following simultaneous crop failures in Africa, South Asia, and Central America.

world_news.title: Space Agency Confirms Discovery of Water on Mars Raises New Questions
world_news.summary: Satellite data analysis revealed subsurface liquid water deposits far larger than previously estimated, reigniting debate over the possibility of microbial life.

world_news.title: Major Earthquake Strikes Coastal Region, Tsunami Warning Issued
world_news.summary: A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck early this morning triggering evacuation orders across low-lying coastal communities. Emergency teams are en route.

web_security.title: Critical Zero-Day Vulnerability Discovered in Widely Used Open-Source Library
web_security.summary: Security researchers have disclosed an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw affecting millions of servers worldwide. A patch is available and immediate updates are urged.

web_security.title: Ransomware Gang Demands $50M After Crippling Hospital Network Across Three Countries
web_security.summary: A sophisticated ransomware attack encrypted patient records across 47 hospitals, forcing staff to revert to paper-based systems. Law enforcement agencies are investigating.

web_security.title: Nation-State Hackers Breach Government Contractor, Steal Classified Defense Plans
web_security.summary: Investigators traced the intrusion to a spear-phishing campaign that compromised credentials of a senior engineer. The breach went undetected for nine months.

web_security.title: New Malware Campaign Targets Banking Apps on Android Devices Globally
web_security.summary: The malware, distributed via seemingly legitimate apps, harvests credentials and intercepts two-factor authentication codes before forwarding them to command-and-control servers.

web_security.title: Supply Chain Attack Compromises Popular Developer Tool Used by Fortune 500 Companies
web_security.summary: Attackers inserted malicious code into a build pipeline update that was automatically distributed to thousands of organisations before the compromise was detected.
